t.zh: 这一关有加法的定义：0 + y = y，S x + y = S (x + y)。核比较两个类型之前，先按定义把它们算到底，算出来一样，就是一样。
t.en: This level has the definition of addition: 0 + y = y and S x + y = S (x + y). Before comparing two types, the kernel works them out by the definitions; if they come out alike, they are alike.

after.zh: 按定义算得出的相等，叫<wiki-ref to="defeq"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: An equality that comes out by working the definitions is a <wiki-ref to="defeq"></wiki-ref>.
